svg.title: Network — transactional fit and operating fit
svg.desc: A comparison of transactional fit across Xunhuanmiao and Bunbun Vintage, followed by a comparison of how different part-time strengths matched the shop’s operating needs. Matching-size photos show Xiamen Galaxy COCO Park Mall and DYN Park (退化公园).
svg.text: NETWORK
What made a connection useful in practice?
CONSIGNMENT PARTNERS · SCALE AND TRANSACTIONAL FIT
XUNHUANMIAO / LOOP MIAO
A larger, established brand inside Xiamen Galaxy COCO Park Mall
Consignment, sales, settlement, and customer service.
More explanation was needed for Remake, indicating lower
transactional fit in this setting.
BUNBUN VINTAGE
Met at a market stall; studio in DYN Park (退化公园)
Vintage niche, customer rapport, and aesthetic alignment.
Remake was understood with less explanation, indicating
stronger product-to-channel fit.

image.aria-label: Xiamen Galaxy COCO Park Mall exterior
DYN Park, marked 退化公园

svg.text: PART-TIME WORK · MATCHING STRENGTHS TO OPERATING NEEDS
EARLIER PART-TIME HIRES
Each brought a different strength.
One suited product photography but was reserved; another
communicated and organized well but did not understand the
category or take on content production.
No walk-in customers came during this period.
INDIVIDUAL STRENGTH ≠ OPERATING FIT
XIAO ZHAO · PART-TIME
University student; her first job; she travelled by ferry
from a nearby city each weekend.
1. Studied comparable vintage stores systematically.
2. Understood and cared about vintage and Remake.
3. Followed operating basics and carried assigned work through.
After she joined: first customer, repeatedly purchased items,
and returning customers who came specifically to the shop.
PRACTICE JUDGMENT · PRODUCT UNDERSTANDING + AESTHETIC FIT
